featured.videoTitle: Frontloading Life Skills During the 11–14 Window – ISEP Webinar
featured.title: Frontloading Life Skills During the 11–14 Window
featured.speaker: Z Reznichek — Teacher-Gamer
featured.description: Exploring practical ‘eruptive methodologies’ that are embodied, off-screen, and collective — moving through ‘possibility thinking’ into PBL, SEL, GBL and world-building role-playing games that are, pedagogically speaking, co-designed learning environments for agency, risk, and imagination in this Window of Wonder from 11–14 years old.
